name: blu
description: Read campaign status and aggregate delivery results from your blü account.

interface.longDescription: Developed and maintained by blü. Connect your existing blü account to inspect campaigns sent through its Cloud API channels. View campaign status, aggregate sent, delivered, read and failed totals, failure codes and stop reasons. Admins see their organization's campaigns; operators see campaigns for their assigned channels. Access is read-only: the plugin cannot send messages, create or change campaigns, or show contacts or message text.
defaultPrompt: How did my latest Cloud API campaign in blü perform?
List my Cloud API campaigns from this month in blü.
Why did messages fail in my last blü campaign?

positive.description: List the connected organization's official campaigns with delivery totals.
positive.prompt: List my official WhatsApp campaigns in blü.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sample organization's four official campaigns, newest first (Oct 14, Oct 7, Sep 30 and Sep 16, 2026), each with its status, WhatsApp number name, template name and recipients, sent, delivered, read and failed totals. The Oct 14 campaign shows 1,200 recipients, 1,170 sent, 1,140 delivered, 860 read and 40 failed.

positive.description: Report the newest campaign's detailed results.
positive.prompt: How did my latest official WhatsApp campaign in blü perform?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Oct 14, 2026 campaign (template promo_outubro_amostra, number Loja Exemplo) and reports its stored results: 1,200 recipients, 1,170 sent, 1,140 delivered, 860 read, 40 failed, 10 not sent and 20 opted out, with WhatsApp error codes 131026 (24) and 131049 (16). It doesn't invent other causes or numbers.

positive.description: Explain why a campaign stopped, from its stop reason and failure codes.
positive.prompt: Why did my blü campaign that ended with an error stop, and which errors did it have?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the Oct 7, 2026 campaign (status error, number Suporte Exemplo, template lembrete_pagamento_amostra) and reports its stop reason, 'O canal foi desconectado durante o envio.' (the number was disconnected while sending), with 500 recipients, 210 sent and 10 failed with WhatsApp error code 131026.

positive.description: Page through campaigns with the returned cursor.
positive.prompt: Show my two most recent official campaigns in blü, then the next two.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_official_campaigns with limit 2, then again with the returned next_cursor. The first page has the Oct 14 and Oct 7, 2026 campaigns; the second has the Sep 30 and Sep 16 campaigns, with no campaign repeated.

positive.description: Compare campaigns using the returned totals.
positive.prompt: Which of my official blü campaigns had the best read rate?
positive.expected_behavior: Compares read against sent (or delivered) for the four campaigns and names the Sep 30, 2026 campaign (template boas_vindas_amostra): 240 read of 292 sent, about 82%. Rates are computed only from the returned totals.

negative.description: Sending messages or creating campaigns isn't supported: the plugin is read-only and has no write tool.
negative.prompt: Send a WhatsApp campaign to all my contacts in blü now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the blü plugin can only read campaign results and can't send messages or create campaigns. No message is sent and nothing changes in blü.

negative.description: Recipients, phone numbers and message text aren't available through the plugin.
negative.prompt: Show the phone numbers of the people who received my last blü campaign and the message they got.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the plugin returns aggregate results only, without recipients, phone numbers or message text, and doesn't invent them. It may offer the campaign's totals instead.

negative.description: A request unrelated to blü campaign results shouldn't call the plugin's tools.
negative.prompt: Write a short WhatsApp promotion for my bakery's weekend sale.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT writes the text itself without calling blü tools, since it doesn't involve reading campaign results. Nothing is sent or saved in blü.

review.commerce_description: The plugin doesn't sell products or process payments. It reads campaign results for existing blü customers.

publication.release_notes: Revises the listing to identify blü as the developer and removes third-party brand names and endorsement-like wording from the public descriptions, keywords and suggested prompts. Clarifies the existing Cloud API campaign scope. Campaign reporting, read-only permissions and the review walkthrough are unchanged.
